title: Billed Amount of a Work Conditioning or Work Hardening Program Day
content:
# Billed amount of a program day

**§1.** A program day of an hour-billed program of the Workers' Compensation Referral — the Work Conditioning Program or the Work Hardening Program — is billed at the program's hourly unit rate for each program hour recorded for the day.

**§2.** A program day of an hour-billed program is billed on the program hours recorded for that date of service, split into re-test hours and conditioning hours, and its billed amount is the conditioning amount plus the re-test hours times the re-test hourly rate, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount.

**§3.** The conditioning hours are the recorded program hours less the re-test hours.

**§4.** The evaluation date of service is the date of service of the referral's evaluation charge.

## The amount, element by element

| Element | Definition |
|---|---|
| Program hours of the day | the program hours recorded on the referral for that date of service |
| Conditioning hours | the program hours of the day less the re-test hours |
| Billed amount | the conditioning amount, plus the re-test hours multiplied by the re-test hourly rate |
| Rounding | half up to the cent, once, on the final billed amount only |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A program day is recorded at 4 program hours in a program whose hourly unit rate is $64.00. Each hour is billed at $64.00, so the billed amount is 4 multiplied by $64.00, that is $256.00.

## Rounding point (hypothetical)

Where a billed amount works out to a fraction of a cent — for instance a total of $310.125 — it is rounded half up once, on that final amount, to $310.13; no element is rounded on its own before the total is taken.
